entries.title: Brainattic / Grokvideo
entries.subtitle: Scientific Advisor (Acquired by Master The Monster | 2019 - 2023)

items.text: Guided research in cross-modal information retrieval algorithms for video streams.
Co-developed a video search engine and automated movie trailer generation using multimodal embeddings (audio, video, text) and deep learning models.
Guided research on AI-based inspection systems for vehicle damage detection.
Fine-tuned open-source semantic segmentation models (Mask R-CNN) on car dent/scratch images and designed an active learning pipeline that grew the annotation dataset to ~500k instances.
Advise on computer vision architectures and statistical modeling for AI-enabled at-home eye diagnostic tests, connecting patient-operated devices to automated clinical optometry reports.
Co-founded and developed a computer vision scratches and flaws detection engine, scaling inspections on high-resolution industrial surfaces. Ranked 4th/130 at JSC 2017.
Implemented and deployed a deep learning-based car damages detector on high-resolution photos using Mask R-CNN.
Built and optimized a multi-output multi-class VGGNet to automatically predict the product category and price of classified listings from photos.
